title: Define audit root signing policy
summary: Record the first public policy for signing audit roots and publishing verifiable provenance without overclaiming immutable transparency.
expectedFailureModes: Audit integrity remains local-only while docs imply public verifiability.
Signing identity, key rotation, and root subject formats are left ambiguous.
Release artifacts cannot tie audit roots to task and commit provenance.
nextAction: Integrated locally; next hardening should implement audit-root-attestation.v1 payload generation and verification.
